summary.zh: 三个主力法术伤害提高 5%，火焰图腾与熔岩震击提高 15%，元素集中再提供免费施法。
summary.en: 5% more damage on your three main spells, 15% on fire totems and Flame Shock, and Elemental Focus for free casts.

scenario.zh: 10–20 级，远程施放闪电箭与震击
scenario.en: Levels 10–20, casting Lightning Bolt and shocks from range

pros.zh: 震荡让闪电箭、闪电链与地震术的伤害提高 5%。
pros.en: Concussion raises Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning and Earth Shock damage by 5%.

pros.zh: 烈焰召唤让火焰图腾、熔岩震击与火焰新星的伤害提高 15%，放下火焰图腾时这就是你的主要伤害。
pros.en: Call of Flame adds 15% to your Fire Totems, Flame Shock and Fire Nova, which is most of your damage whenever a fire totem is down.

pros.zh: 元素集中让任何火焰、冰霜或自然法术之后有 10% 几率进入激活状态，而这个等级真正的瓶颈就是法力。
pros.en: Elemental Focus gives a 10% chance of a Clearcasting state after any Fire, Frost or Nature spell, and at this level Mana is the real constraint.

pros.zh: 元素灵敏缩短闪电箭与熔岩爆裂的施法时间；如果先见底的是法力而不是施法时间，就把这 2 点移到传导。
pros.en: Elemental Alacrity shortens Lightning Bolt and Lava Burst cast times; swap those two points into Convection if Mana runs out before cast time does.

provenance.source: wowhandbook.com recommended builds, beta client data
provenance.notes: Beta build 1.60.1.70425 recommendations; may change before launch.
